subject: Biotechnology
title: Biotech and COVID Vaccines
description: A quick win: understand Biotech and COVID Vaccines.

hook.text: The Pfizer-BioNTech COVID vaccine was designed in just two days — decades of biotech made it possible.

buildup.text: mRNA vaccines deliver genetic instructions — your cells make the spike protein and the immune system learns it.

discovery.text: Katalin Karikó spent decades solving mRNA instability — modified nucleosides prevented immune destruction.

twist.text: Lipid nanoparticle delivery was the other half — without the fat bubble, mRNA degrades in seconds.

climax.text: Billions of mRNA doses were manufactured in under a year — the fastest vaccine rollout in history.

punchline.text: Decades of ignored research became the pandemic's answer.

quiz.question: What breakthrough made mRNA vaccines possible?
options: Discovering that mRNA naturally survives in blood for weeks
Modified nucleosides that prevent the immune system from destroying the mRNA
Using CRISPR to insert mRNA directly into human DNA
